Steps:
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/ui#/catalog
[WAIT] Catalog blade loaded
[ACT] click first catalog row; navigate to products grid
[ASSERT] capture first 3 product names in current default order
[ACT] click the 'Name' column header to sort ascending
[WAIT] grid re-renders with sorted order
[ACT] click the 'Name' column header again to sort descending
[WAIT] grid re-renders
Assertions:
[DOM] Name column header shows sort indicator (up arrow) after first click
[GRID] product names are in ascending alphabetical order after first click
[DOM] sort indicator changes to down arrow after second click
[GRID] product names are in descending alphabetical order after second click
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/search/products body: {"sort": "name:asc", "take": 10} → 200; returned item names are in ascending order
Failure_Signals: Column header not clickable, sort indicator absent after click, row order unchanged after clicking header, ascending and descending produce identical order (sort not implemented), Angular error on sort
